label: PILOT

follower.projection: Nearest polyline projection; nondecreasing arclength progress
follower.target: Interpolate at progress + lookahead, clamped to path end
follower.speed_policy: Constant 0.2m/s; zero v,w only within 0.01m of path endpoint
follower.angular_policy: w = clip(v * curvature, -0.4, +0.4); no curvature-dependent speed reduction

chunk: Sample 0 native 8 XY points, observation-anchored world frame; no appended origin, connector, extrapolation, yaw or timestamps
switch: Next valid 9Hz tick; reset progress on new chunk only
invalid_path: Fewer than two distinct adjacent finite points: stop until next valid chunk; adjacent duplicate tolerance unchanged at 1e-12m
timeout: Original host receive age < 1s; missing/expired stop
tangent_diagnostic: Independent nearest projections of OLD/FRESH at the same B; outgoing segment, last incoming at endpoint. Short segments invalid. Not physical correspondence or robot yaw.
endpoint_clamp_definition: progress + 0.25 > path length; target clipped to last waypoint
safety: Oracle geometry after executed intervals only; unchanged collision/corridor termination, margin violation recorded without command override
violation_duration: Sum positive-duration 72Hz intervals whose swept lower bound is <0.02m for any obstacle; count interval once
comparison: Stored original-PD reference only, descriptive unpaired comparison
